rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for spaghetti as either the pasta itself or a dish made with it.
A speaker uses this fuller form when naming the pasta or dish more explicitly than 意粉.

example.english: I bought a pack of spaghetti to take home.
example.traditional: 我買咗包意大利粉返屋企。
